response.text:
I can help, but I need a few details and your explicit confirmation before I make any changes.

Uncertainties I need to clarify up front
- I don’t know which sender you mean (email address or name).
- I don’t know which email account/mailbox to act on.
- “While I am away” is ambiguous — do you want the action to start now, only during a date range, or permanently?
- I can perform actions now (archive threads, create a mail rule) but I do not have the ability to run independent background tasks beyond this conversation, so I can’t autonomously “notify you tomorrow” unless you allow me to schedule a reminder or send a message using an account/integration I already have access to.

Please confirm the following and pick options
1) Sender to archive: provide the exact email address (e.g., alice@example.com) or the display name as it appears in your mailbox.
2) Which account/mailbox: tell me which email account to use (or confirm I should act in the account linked to this assistant).
3) Exact action: I will archive threads (remove from inbox, keep in All Mail). Confirm you want ARCHIVE, not DELETE/TRASH.
4) Scope:
   - A: Archive all existing threads from this sender now.
   - B: Create a rule/filter so future messages from this sender are auto-archived.
   - C: Both A and B.
5) Notification tomorrow:
   - How do you want notified? (email to X, SMS to Y, calendar reminder, or other). If you want an automated notification, confirm whether I may create a calendar event or send a scheduled message using your linked calendar/mail account. If you do not grant scheduling access, I can instead draft the notification now for you to schedule, or give step-by-step instructions to set a reminder.

If you want me to proceed now, reply with:
- The sender email,
- The mailbox/account,
- Which scope option (A, B, or C),
- Confirmation that ARCHIVE (not delete) is intended,
- How you want to be notified tomorrow and whether I may create/send a scheduled notification using your account.

Example reply you can copy & paste to confirm:
"Yes — archive now. Sender: alice@example.com. Account: mywork@example.com. Scope: C (archive existing and auto-archive future). Notify by email to mywork@example.com tomorrow and you may schedule/send it."

I’ll wait for your confirmation and details before taking any destructive action.
